scripts.build: node scripts/build_android_spatial.js && vite build && (cp -r web/.well-known dist/ 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp -r web/js dist/ 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp -r web/fonts dist/ 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp -r web/sounds dist/ 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp -r web/models dist/ 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp web/*.png dist/ 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp web/*.svg dist/ 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp web/version.json dist/ 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp web/robots.txt dist/ 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp web/sitemap*.xml dist/ 2>/dev/null || true) && (mkdir -p dist/apk && cp app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk dist/apk/app-liquid-glass-updated.apk 2>/dev/null || true)
scripts.release: ./gradlew syncReleaseApk && npm run build && npx vercel --prod --yes
